free_features.name: Guardian tree finder
free_features.text: Enter a birth month and day to find the matching tree from the 13 trees of the Celtic tree calendar. A cultural feature, not a scientific claim.

audiences.buyers: Households in Dublin buying a Christmas tree, people giving a tree as a gift, and businesses ordering trees.

beacon.data_protection: Details typed into the reservation form (name, email, interests, chosen tree, area or Eircode, certificate wording) are saved in the owner's order list (a Cloudflare database set up to be stored in Europe, readable only by the owner) and emailed to the owner through the form-to-email service FormSubmit; if the order list cannot be reached the visitor's own email app is used. They are used only to reply, confirm and arrange delivery, and erased on request. The site uses no cookies, no analytics and no third-party fonts or scripts.

proof.note: No customers, partners, certifications or awards are announced.

agent_may_not: promise a delivery date or stock

beacon.agent_card_note: No A2A agent card is published for this business; use the human handoff.
